entries.descriptionOriginal: 🗒️ 99 NIGHTS INTO HELLO NEIGHBOR. You thought moving to a new neighborhood was a fresh start. You were wrong. Your neighbor isn't just hiding a secret in his basement. He's hiding a timeline. You have 99 nights to uncover what he's building, what he's keeping, and why the days keep repeating. Every time you get caught, you wake up on Day 1. Every time you escape, the house changes. He learns. He remembers. And he's not letting you leave until he decides you're ready to stay forever. 🗒️!! 🏠 99 Nights. One Neighbor.
